QuestInfo.name: The Rememberer's Spring Flower Research 2
QuestInfo.0: Spring blooms in Maple World. You hear that #bThe Rememberer in Sleepywood#k is researching spring flowers but he needs your help. Let's go talk to him.
QuestInfo.1: Let's help with the research to plant far more spring flowers!
QuestInfo.2: You successfully helped with the Spring Flower Research and finally, far more spring flowers bloom in Maple World.
QuestInfo.summary: Give 3 Forsythias to The Rememberer in Sleepywood.

0.0: Did you know that we are researching spring flowers for planting? We want far more of them in the Maple World! Your flowers will be a great help to our research.

yes.0: It will be a great help to the research on spring flowers in Maple World if you can deliver #b3 Azaleas#k to #bThe Rememberer in Sleepywood#k.  Hope you can do this now.

1.0: I have a lot of work to do... so I can't go find spring flowers now...  Oh! Did you bring some Forsythias for me?

yes.0: Thank you for bringing me Forsythias! I couldn't collect them by myself because I have a lot of work to do... anyway thank you so much!
yes.1: Forsythias mean 'hope'. I wish this yellow forsythia will spread hope around Maple World! I will give you a #bForsythia Sticker#k to always keep a hopeful mind.

npc.0: Why didn't you go to The Rememberer quickly? You have to go to Sleepywood and give her #b3 Azaleas#k.

item.0: Are you sure that you brought me #b3 Forsythias#k? I am so busy doing a lot of work.
